findings.detail: Replica SGD uses bootstrap-resampled rows, but each replica's codebooks are initialized by KMeans on the entire unresampled training embedding set. Thus the replicas are not fitted solely on their specified bootstrap resamples; their initial quantizers share a full-training-data initialization, weakening the intended independent bootstrap estimator.
findings.reproduction: In the replica loop, the call at line 294 passes all train_embeddings to init_codebook before replica_data is constructed from sampled indices at lines 297-299. For any bootstrap draw omitting a training item, that item still influences the replica's initial KMeans centers.
findings.correction: Draw sampled indices before initialization and initialize each replica's codebooks from the corresponding bootstrap sample (while retaining the same architecture, hyperparameters, and independent seed).

findings.detail: The single-GPU launcher references _LAUNCHER['single_visible_dev'], but the final _LAUNCHER definition at lines 128-135 does not define that key. Since resolve_single_gpu() selects this branch when at most one GPU is visible, the actual entry point raises KeyError before starting training when CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is unset.
findings.reproduction: Run the script entry point on a one-GPU host with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES unset (or with no CUDA devices): resolve_single_gpu() returns true and line 524 evaluates the missing dictionary key.
findings.correction: Add the intended single_visible_dev value to the effective _LAUNCHER mapping, or avoid assigning CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES when it is absent; smoke-test the entry point in single-GPU mode as well as torchrun mode.
